## Learning Objectives

By the end of this chapter, you will be able to:

- Filter data using complex conditions and logical operators
- Select and rename columns effectively
- Create calculated columns and transformations
- Chain multiple operations in analysis pipelines

Filtering, selecting, and transforming data are the bread and butter of data analysis. If
you master these three operations, you can solve 80% of real-world data problems.
